Subject: Nova Bank — procurement & vendor onboarding follow-up

Hi Liam / Nova Bank procurement team,

Thanks again for the call earlier today — appreciate you walking us through the payments platform requirements and procurement cadence. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of what I heard
- Economic buyer: Liam O'Connor (Head of Payments) – final approval expected from VP Finance for PO
- Security/legal: you need SOC 2 summary, network diagram, and an entry in your vendor portal before contract signing
- Procurement steps: vendor onboarding form, tax/W-9, vendor code creation, PO issuance via Workday
- Decision criteria: latency SLAs, data residency (US-only for this workload), and SSO/SAML support

Action items / next steps
- Marissa (me): share SOC2 summary and vendor onboarding template (attached) — DONE (see attachments)
- Nikhil: will pull together commercial summary and sample SOW for procurement to include with PO
- Monica: will schedule onboarding kickoff once vendor profile is created

Tentative timeline from conversation: vendor onboarding complete by 2026-09-15, PO issued by 2026-09-22. Please confirm if that matches your expectations or if we should adjust.

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx

Can you please confirm the procurement contact who'll own vendor profile creation and the PO approver name? Also, if you use a specific procurement system (Ariba/Workday/Coupa) let us know so we can format the onboarding form accordingly.

If it's helpful, I can set up a 30-min follow-up next week to walk through the onboarding form with your team.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
